cards.ex: The survey focused on people in the 55-65 age bracket.
cards.exUz: So'rov 55-65 yosh toifasidagi odamlarga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni yoshiga qarab guruhlash, yosh oralig'i.

cards.ex: They're debating raising the retirement age to 70.
cards.exUz: Ular pensiya yoshini 70 ga ko'tarishni muhokama qilishmoqda.

cards.ex: He's looking forward to his rocking chair years after a lifetime of hard work.
cards.exUz: U umr bo'yi qattiq mehnatdan so'ng qarilik davrini intiqlik bilan kutmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarilik, dam olish davri, hech narsa qilmaslik.

cards.ex: Long-term care facilities are becoming increasingly expensive.
cards.exUz: Uzoq muddatli parvarishlash muassasalari tobora qimmatlashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida sog'lig'i yomon odamlarga tibbiy yordam.

cards.ex: I'm worried about healthcare costs down the road.
cards.exUz: Kelajakda sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlari meni tashvishlantiradi.

cards.ex: The healthcare system is experiencing some growing pains as the population ages.
cards.exUz: Aholi soni o'sishi bilan sog'liqni saqlash tizimi ba'zi qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirmoqda.

cards.ex: She's starting to experience some age-related health problems.
cards.exUz: U yoshga bog'liq sog'liq muammolarini boshdan kechiryapti.

cards.ex: Many people worry about running out of retirement savings.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar pension jamg'armasining tugab qolishidan xavotirda.

cards.ex: Living expenses tend to increase as people get older.
cards.exUz: Odamlar qarigan sayin tirikchilik xarajatlari ko'payadi.
cards.uzDef: Hayot kechirish uchun zarur bo'lgan pul.

cards.ex: Don't forget to ask for the senior discount at the restaurant.
cards.exUz: Restoranda pensioner chegirmasini so'rashni unutmang.

cards.ex: He does crossword puzzles to stay sharp in his retirement.
cards.exUz: U pensiyada aqlini saqlash uchun krossvordlar echadi.

cards.ex: She decided to downshift and work part-time before fully retiring.
cards.exUz: U to'liq pensiyaga chiqishdan oldin sekinlashishga va yarim kunlik ishga o'tishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: The 'silver tsunami' is putting a strain on social security systems.
cards.exUz: 'Qarilik to'lqini' ijtimoiy ta'minot tizimlariga bosim o'tkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Aholi sonining qarishi tufayli yuzaga keladigan muammolar.

cards.ex: We need to fight against ageism in the workplace.
cards.exUz: Biz ish joyida yoshga qarab kamsitishga qarshi kurashishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yoshga qarab kamsitish, odamlarga nisbatan noto'g'ri munosabat.

cards.ex: Many people are now outliving their parents.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar hozir ota-onalaridan ko'ra uzoqroq yashamoqda.

cards.ex: She lived a full and happy life well into old age.
cards.exUz: U qarilikka qadar to'la va baxtli hayot kechirdi.

cards.ex: They moved to a retirement community in Florida.
cards.exUz: Ular Florida shtatidagi pensionerlar shaharchasiga ko'chib o'tishdi.
cards.uzDef: Pensionerlar uchun maxsus qurilgan uy-joy majmuasi.

cards.ex: She's really aged well; she looks much younger than her age.
cards.exUz: U juda yaxshi qarigan; u yoshidan ancha yosh ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lig'ini va tashqi ko'rinishini yaxshi saqlagan holda qarimoq.

cards.ex: Many retirees live on a fixed income.
cards.exUz: Ko'p nafaqaxo'rlar qatiy daromad bilan yashaydilar.

cards.ex: As I get along in years, I appreciate simple things more.
cards.exUz: Yillar o'tishi bilan oddiy narsalarni ko'proq qadrlay boshladim.

cards.ex: She swears by wrinkle cream to keep her skin looking young.
cards.exUz: U terisini yosh ko'rinishda saqlash uchun ajin kremiga qasam ichadi.

cards.ex: Life expectancy has increased significantly in recent decades.
cards.exUz: So'nggi o'n yilliklarda umr ko'rish davomiyligi sezilarli darajada oshdi.
cards.uzDef: O'rtacha odam yashashi mumkin bo'lgan yillar soni.

cards.ex: He had to retire due to declining health.
cards.exUz: U sog'lig'i yomonlashgani sababli nafaqaga chiqishga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: Out-of-pocket healthcare costs can be a burden for seniors.
cards.exUz: Shaxsiy sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlari keksa odamlar uchun og'irlik bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: There's a shortage of affordable senior housing in the city.
cards.exUz: Shaharda arzon keksa yashash joylari yetishmaydi.

cards.ex: She has to look after her elderly mother.
cards.exUz: U keksa onasiga g'amxo'rlik qilishi kerak.

cards.ex: He's starting to wind down before retirement.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqishdan oldin dam olib, tinchlana boshladi.

cards.ex: Exercise and a healthy diet can add years to your life.
cards.exUz: Jismoniy mashqlar va sog'lom ovqatlanish hayotingizga yillar qo'shishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom turmush tarzi bilan umrni uzaytirish.

cards.ex: He's getting on a bit now, but still very active.
cards.exUz: U hozir biroz qarib qolgan, ammo hali ham juda faol.

cards.ex: The 'third age' is a time for pursuing new interests and hobbies.
cards.exUz: 'Uchinchi davr' yangi qiziqishlar va mashg'ulotlarni davom ettirish vaqti.
